about: Labels changed by hand, each with the library source that shows it (bench/holdout/README.md: call breaks found by binding are checked against the source at `to`, here read from the release's wheel). A use overridden here is excluded.

overrides.why: at 1.7.4 ChatOpenAI declares `max_tokens: int | None = Field(default=None, alias="max_completion_tokens")`, so the signature pydantic builds lists the alias; BaseChatOpenAI's `model_config = ConfigDict(populate_by_name=True)` makes the model accept the field's own name too, so `ChatOpenAI(max_tokens=...)` still works (the class docstring's own example passes `max_tokens=None`)
overrides.evidence: langchain_openai-1.7.4 wheel, langchain_openai/chat_models/base.py line 3798 (the field on ChatOpenAI), line 1306 (`model_config` on BaseChatOpenAI, which ChatOpenAI subclasses at line 2928 without its own) and line 2991 (the docstring example)
